raw_sections.experience:
Transformation, and Operating Model: Digital, Business, 
Wells Fargo | Sr. Strategy & Planning Consultant (AVP) – Enterprise Strategy | July 2024 – May 2026
Strategy & Value Advisory • Advised Commercial Banking leadership on healthcare growth strategy by identifying a $630M revenue opportunity from a targeted 5% market share increase, assessing a $15B healthcare banking market, benchmarking competitors, and refining product positioning and client coverage to shape the 2025–2027 growth roadmap.
Led Commercial Card strategy through market sizing, customer research, and competitor benchmarking, delivering recommendations that enhanced product positioning and growth opportunities.
Designed a relationship-led banking model and go-to-market roadmap for the $0–25M revenue segment, addressing low product penetration and negative customer perception to drive deeper wallet share and improve long-term profitability.
Transformation, and Operating Model • Led cross-functional AI transformation initiatives, partnering with senior leadership to drive alignment and deliver measurable impact across
operational efficiency, FTE optimization, and cost savings.
Established an enterprise operating model and PMO governance framework across 25+ stakeholders, integrating prioritization processes, RAID management, KPI/OKR dashboards, dependency tracking, and AI-enabled workflow automation to improve execution visibility, reduce backlog, mitigate risks, and drive operational efficiency.
C-Suite Advisory and Stakeholder Management • Delivered and presented a quarterly strategic pulse report on covering macroeconomic trends, competitive landscape dynamics for Wells Fargo's
Wealth & Investment Management and Corporate & Investment Banking leadership teams.
Partnered with senior leadership across different LOBs to drive cross-functional alignment on AI transformation priorities and measurable impact.
First Quadrant Advisory (FQA) | Associate - Strategy Consultant | June 2021 – March 2024
Strategy & Value Advisory • Led market assessment, product, and commercialization strategy for a SaaS platform, identifying a product-specific TAM of $600M and SOM

potential of up to $49.5M. Identified a $9.8B market opportunity for BPM/ITO/cloud capabilities by leading growth strategy, commercialization planning, market sizing, and competitive assessments, culminating in an executive-level business case that informed portfolio prioritization, and GTM decisions
Partnered with solution and sales teams to develop value hypotheses, TCO, and ROI narratives for 10+ digital solutions, quantifying cost savings, productivity improvements, implementation investments, and financial returns to support executive buying decisions.
Supported business case development and investment prioritization for digital product commercialization initiatives across multiple enterprise functions.
Transformation, Operating Model & Governance • Designed the target operating model and governance structure supporting client’s transition to a global managed-services organization
operating across India and the Philippines.
Developed enterprise transformation initiatives through operating model redesign, process optimization, organizational alignment, and commercialization capability development.
Established robust business unit governance by building OKR/KPI reporting frameworks and executive dashboards; facilitated MBR, WBR, and QBR cycles that drove cross-functional accountability and informed C-suite investment priorities.
Sales Strategy and Solution Design • Developed sales transformation & enablement toolkit frameworks covering opportunity & lead qualification, RACI for deal pursuit, pursuit
governance, solution reviews, client presentations, and negotiation management.
Enabled enterprise sales teams to pursue high-value transformation opportunities by architecting 20+ solution proposals and 10+ RFP responses, aligning product, technology, and operations capabilities with client business objectives and transformation priorities.
C-Suite Advisory and Stakeholder Management • Owned end-to-end storyboarding and strategic messaging for CXO steering committees, translating complex delivery data and risk signals into
concise, decision-ready executive narratives.
Led the creation of high-impact board and C – Suite - facing presentations for quarterly business reviews and governance forums, ensuring rigorous strategic framing and consistency across all senior materials.
Skeiron Group | Strategy & Investment Analyst | Dec 2019 - June 2021 • Supported the Strategy Director and CEO on investment priorities by building business cases, executive-ready dashboards, progress trackers, and
strategic insight reports—improving delivery visibility and enabling structured decision-making across the portfolio.
Led strategic assessments of 5+ business ideas, evaluating market attractiveness, competitive differentiation, growth opportunities, and business challenges, financial model, and presented executive-ready recommendations to senior leadership on investment, positioning, and go-forward strategy.
Led cross-functional stakeholder alignment across Finance, Operations, HR, Delivery, and Technology by implementing governance structures, performance dashboards, and milestone tracking processes that strengthened accountability, improved decision-making, and enabled proactive risk management.
Authored high-visibility leadership materials, including investment decision papers, market intelligence reports, and transformation roadmaps that directly shaped corporate growth strategies, operating model redesigns, and M&A decisions.
MarketsandMarkets | Strategy & Market Intelligence Consultant | Dec 2016 – Dec 2019 • Developed a $100M growth roadmap for a healthcare SaaS firm by prioritizing 8 market segments, identifying adjacent growth opportunities,
and defining capability investments, GTM strategy, and competitive positioning.
Conducted 25+ strategic market assessments for Fortune 500 clients, analyzing industry trends, disruption scenarios, competitive landscapes, market opportunities, and customer value propositions to support corporate growth, product, and market-entry strategies.
Developed strategic solution proposals by assessing client business models, operational challenges, and growth objectives, designing tailored solutions and business cases that identified new revenue opportunities and supported multi-million-dollar pursuit and growth initiatives.
T&A CONSULTING | Strategy & Investment Market Intelligence | March 2016 – Dec 2016 • South Carolina Department of Commerce, driving partnerships with CXOs and government stakeholders while advancing priority accounts
through on-ground engagement, feasibility assessment, and value proposition alignment.
Supported market research and competitive intelligence engagements for EU, US, and APAC clients, contributing to industry analysis, business opportunity assessments, and executive briefing materials.
